description.narrative: (Tanzania): The Mwanamke Imara ("Women's Empowerment") program supports a consortium of local organizations, committed to women's empowerment, that are organizing advocacy efforts, providing legal assistance, and bolstering livelihoods for women in Tanzania. Under this program, the U.S government will strengthen the capacity of Tanzanian organizations to empower women and bolster their leadership in areas related to access to justice, economic participation, and community decision-making..&amp;amp;amp;lt;!--td {border: 1px solid #ccc;}br {mso-data-placement:same-cell;}--&amp;amp;amp;gt;
